calls.statement:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS d, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY ALL

SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.order_ts_utc, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-27' AND DATE '2025-11-29'
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS d,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled') AS non_cancelled,
 COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled') AS d_non_cancelled,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='processing') AS processing,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment_type='click_and_collect') AS cc,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') AS helsinki_day
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
